title: [SSH] Add support of Post-Quantum KEM sntrup761x25519-sha512 + mlkem768x25519-sha256 (+decryption)
description:
This merge request to start to add support of Post Quantum algorithms used in 2025 in hybrid KEMs used by SSH.
(it becomes possible to live decrypt today's SSH flow)  

This first implementation is working for hybrid KEM `sntrup761x25519` + `mlkem768x25519` and had been successfully tested with cipher `chacha20-poly1305` and with cipher `aes256-gcm`

When I say working, I want to say that providing an SSH keylog file Wireshark + TShark are able to decrypt traffic on the fly when `sntrup761x25519` / `mlkem768x25519`  + `chacha20-poly1305` / `aes256-gcm` are used (maybe other cipher are working too but I didn't test)


The following command capture and live decrypt SSH flow: 

```bash
tshark -i enp0s3 -n \
-o ssh.keylog_file:/home/nba/ssh1_key.log \
-o ssh.desegment_buffers:TRUE \
-o tcp.desegment_tcp_streams:TRUE \
-t ad -l \
-f 'host 10.0.50.78 and host 10.0.50.25 and port 22' \
-T fields \
-e frame.number \
-e frame.time_relative \
-e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.srcport -e tcp.dstport -e tcp.len -e _ws.col.Protocol -e _ws.col.Info -e ssh.payload  -e ssh.cookie \
-e ssh.message_code  \
-o ssh.debug_file:/home/nba/deb.ssh \
--log-level noisy
--log-domain packet-ssh
```

You must provide a keylog file containing the **shared_secret** in the following format (describes in the SSH dissector, see epan/dissectors/packet-ssh.c at line ~2480 of the branch nba-2485-sntrup761x25519-sha512 of my forked repo https://gitlab.com/nbanba/wireshark/-/tree/nba-2485-sntrup761x25519-sha512)

```bash
 <cookie> <type> <key>
```

Where \<cookie\> is the hex-encoded (client or server) 16 bytes cookie  
Where \<type\> must be SHARED_SECRET   
Where \<key\> is the hex-encoded shared_secret,   
e.g:  
```bash
35c8c4951a5b4bc0ebfbc58582a883af SHARED_SECRET ee13cfe77eb27dd3a911a218e2431ffe6cdd669935ea900aa8f2b4789ffa70c60aa48f4e8a6021789ba617bc2314f633be4de8e7030ee97b5a11348dcf2d985b
e90edd9c84589544b5e62ddc159e33a2 SHARED_SECRET 36ad16c38698411d40fee02d2ec16dedcd941a61f46958a3fc3a40aa2ec4907b6c49cd551cce05526954a023b87d3964ef7cc6b1798fe0dec2ca7577f4e8e572

```

**NB:**  
**This current implementation rely ONLY on SHARED_SECRET.**  
**PRIVATE_KEY is currently NOT supported for Post-Quantum KEX as it required to port in Wireshark Streamline NTRU and Lattice KYBER cryptographic library to compute the SHARED_SECRET from the PRIVATE_KEY.**  
**PRIVATE_KEY support will be added in the future.**   


If you need to patch OpenSSH or a patched version of OpenSSH to derive the shared_secret, you can use this version of OpenSSH-portable I have already patched (you can clone only 1 branch of my fork, for example branch nba-ssh-kl-20250508 which is patched): https://github.com/nbanb/openssh-portable/tree/nba-ssh-kl-20250508
